Derived HIGH (I3, E3+E5, likely) so it GATES under Gate 7 regardless of provenance; ruling on a deletion PR that does not touch the defect is for a non-author adjudicator. Carries I3, so roadmap-parking is barred (Gate 7 constraint 1); existing roadmap issue #1545 (UP-13) holds the viz slice (constraint 2: never re-park).
